about_the_game:
It is the Demo version.

Enter the game, become the ultimate mage, frantically buy cards and castles, summon various creatures, and cast powerful spells in battle.

Defend against impossible enemy attacks, summon foxes, sheep, bears, dragons, ninjas, skeletons, goblins, and the Nine Egyptian Gods, and cast mighty lightning, meteors, and icebergs to turn the tide of battle.

name: Mage of Tempest Castle Demo
short_description: The game mechanics include card combinations, resource management, and tactical deployment. Whether building a powerful army or using extreme tactics, experience becoming a magic master, commanding the battlefield, and defeating the enemy forces in each level.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
